description: Ask FundingTracker to list a funding company (direct funder, ISO/broker or other) in its public funder directory, or to update the facts of a company already listed: max deal, payment schedules, whether it works with ISO brokers, and states served. No sign-in needed; use it only for a company the user represents. FundingTracker emails a confirmation link to contact_email, which should be at the company website's domain (another domain gets a closer review). Nothing is published until that link is opened and FundingTracker approves the listing. Returns the request status, e.g. waiting for email confirmation. One open request per website; rate-limited.

company.description: Company name as it should appear in the directory, e.g. 'Biz Capital Miami'.

contact_email.description: Work email at the company's own domain. A confirmation link is sent here; an email at another domain gets a closer review.

contact_name.description: Name of the person requesting the listing.

max_deal.description: Largest deal funded, in USD, e.g. 250000.

states.description: U.S. states served: 'all' for nationwide, or two-letter codes like ['FL', 'GA', 'TX'].

type.description: 'direct_funder' (funds deals from its own capital), 'broker' (ISO/broker) or 'other'.

works_with_isos.description: Whether the company works with ISO brokers.

name: request_funder_listing
title: Request a funder directory listing
